# ThemeToggle

Light/dark switch that remembers the choice (localStorage kui-theme) and follows the OS when set to System.

`KenosUI.ThemeToggle` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.ThemeToggle />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.ThemeToggle"></x-import>
```
